tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background: birch plywood in light, walnut night in dark. Also the 4px ring around the raised Observe block, the present-mode stage, and the toast text colour (ground on ink, 14.60:1 light, 16.13:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, the bottom bar, idle kid ChoiceCards, emoji pods and the selected block in segmented controls and tabs. A card on surface always carries a 1px line border, in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, menus and popovers. White and lifted by shadow-sheet in light; one step lighter than surface in dark.

tokens.name: tray
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: segmented, tab and support-scale tracks, the search-field fill, the Recent-development quote well, the avatar ground, content-type tiles, Draft and Archived badges, the neutral chip, the kid Done tile and the ghost or secondary hover fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative only: card borders, dividers, the bottom-bar top edge, the side-nav inline-end edge, the avatar edge. Never the only boundary of a control (1.28:1 on ground in light, 2.05:1 in dark).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, search, secondary buttons, unselected toggle chips, checkboxes, radios, feedback and picker tiles. Also the kid Done-tile outline, the timeline string, the sheet grabber, upcoming progress dots and the empty-state floor. At least 3:1 on ground, surface, surface-raised and tray in both themes (3.36 to 5.40).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Graphite in light, chalk in dark. All primary text and every icon outline. Reads on ground, surface, surface-raised, tray, brand-soft, strength-soft, interest-soft, helps-soft, focus-soft and attention-soft (10.17:1 or better in both themes). Also the toast fill and the 3px colouring-book outline of kid tiles.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ages, dates, helper text, placeholders, counts, inactive nav labels and icon outlines, the ghost-button label, the kid Done-tile label. Reads on the same ten grounds as ink: ground, surface, surface-raised, tray, brand-soft and the five -soft tints (5.02:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Toy-block blue: act and you-are-here. As a fill: primary buttons, the centre Observe block, the brand KidButton, check blocks, the current progress dot, the paint of the active nav icon. As text: links, the active nav label, the soft-button label, the Ready badge and the Observe label; reads on ground, surface, surface-raised, tray and brand-soft (5.16:1 or better). As a border: 2px on a selected segment, tab, feedback or picker tile; 4px on a selected kid tile. Links inside running text are always underlined (text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px). Standalone links with an icon or a button shape do not need it.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of brand, and the hover label of the soft button. As text it reads on ground, surface, surface-raised, tray and brand-soft (6.93:1 or better).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: The active nav pill and row, the soft button, the info alert, the done progress dots, the calm kid bubble, and the selected fill of neutral choices (feedback tiles, the content-type picker, the kid Selected tile). Labels on it are ink; brand text on it is the one coloured-text-on-tint pair (5.16:1 light, 5.89:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on solid fills: brand, brand-strong, danger, and any tone ink used as a fill (single-select toggle chip, focus numeral block, success check block). White in light, near-black in dark: never hard-code white on brand.

tokens.name: strength-soft
tokens.usage: Strengths: chip fill, the 32px section tile, the selected multi-select chip fill, the Strength Builder mode tag, the kid Hint tile. Labels on it are ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: strength-ink
tokens.usage: Strengths: the 2px selected-chip border and check, the kid Hint dashed ring, the single-select fill (with on-brand), short tone words. Reads on strength-soft, ground, surface, surface-raised and tray (5.54:1 or better).

tokens.name: interest-soft
tokens.usage: Interests: chip fill (with an emoji pod or the heart icon), the section tile, the selected chip fill. Labels on it are ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: interest-ink
tokens.usage: Interests: the selected-chip border and check, the single-select fill (with on-brand), short tone words. Reads on interest-soft, ground, surface, surface-raised and tray (4.99:1 or better).

tokens.name: helps-soft
tokens.usage: What helps: chip fill, the section tile, the selected chip fill. In present mode only, also the kid Preferred tile and the warm bubble. Never the ground of a system success message.

tokens.name: helps-ink
tokens.usage: What helps: the selected-chip border and check, the single-select fill (with on-brand), short tone words. Source of the success alias. Reads on helps-soft, ground, surface, surface-raised and tray (5.29:1 or better).

tokens.name: focus-soft
tokens.usage: Current focus (grape): chip fill, the section tile, the numbered focus rows, the Growth Support mode tag. Labels on it are ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: focus-ink
tokens.usage: Fill of the 1 to 3 numeral blocks (with an on-brand numeral), the focus selected-chip border, short tone words. Reads on focus-soft, ground, surface, surface-raised and tray (5.38:1 or better).

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: Worth a look, tangerine and never red: the not-observed strip, the sensitivities chip, the Needs-more-observation and Focus-slots-full badges, the warning alert, the kid Other tile, the think kid bubble. Labels on it are ink.

tokens.name: attention-ink
tokens.usage: The 4px kid Other ring and short attention tone words. Source of the warning alias. Reads on attention-soft, ground, surface, surface-raised and tray (4.69:1 or better).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, Approved, Worked-well recorded. As text and as the 1.5px border of success alerts and the Approved badge on surface; as the fill of check blocks (with on-brand). Always with a check glyph and a word, never on a helps-soft fill. Reads on ground, surface and surface-raised (6.05:1 or better).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: System warnings: unsaved changes, offline, video still processing. Always with an alert glyph. Reads on ground, surface, surface-raised and attention-soft (4.69:1 or better).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive confirms only: field error text and the 2px field border, the error-alert border, glyph and title, the Failed badge, the Delete confirm fill (with on-brand) and the ghost Delete label. Never used for anything about a child. Reads on ground, surface, surface-raised and tray (5.14:1 or better). There is deliberately no danger-soft.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 3px outline at a 2px offset on every interactive element (3px offset on kid tiles), so it lands on the ground, never on the control's own fill. 6.19:1 or better on every ground and on brand-soft. Named ring so it never collides with the Current-focus tone. On the ink toast the focus ring is ground (14.60:1 light, 16.13:1 dark).

tokens.name: paint-sun
tokens.usage: Sunflower paint, fill only: the Strengths and Strength Builder stars, the ball in the feedback towers, the kid RoundButton, stickers, the finish-tower ball, the baseline timeline bead, kid picture blocks. Any glyph on it is on-paint.

tokens.name: paint-berry
tokens.usage: Berry paint, fill only: the Interests heart, the finish-tower cube, kid picture blocks.

tokens.name: paint-leaf
tokens.usage: Leaf paint, fill only: the What-helps ticked block, the activity-result bead, the success toast block, kid picture blocks.

tokens.name: paint-grape
tokens.usage: Grape paint, fill only: the Current-focus pennant, the Growth Support pot, the focus-change bead, kid picture blocks.

tokens.name: paint-tangerine
tokens.usage: Tangerine paint, fill only: the attention eye iris, the warning toast block, kid picture blocks.

tokens.name: paint-sky
tokens.usage: The non-meaning paint, fill only, for everyday things: content-type icons, the present icon, the observation bead and quote icon, the info toast block, empty-state scenes, kid picture blocks. Never a profile meaning.

tokens.name: on-paint
tokens.usage: Graphite in both themes: glyphs and labels on any paint, such as toast glyph blocks and the RoundButton arrow and its 3px outline. Reads on every paint-* at 4.56:1 or better (paint-berry in light is the lowest).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fredoka, rounded like a toy block, for Latin and Hebrew. Only on titles, child-facing text, numeral blocks and avatar initials (the logo's wordmark is artwork, never live text); never in buttons, fields, chips, tables or nav labels. No uppercase, letter-spacing or italics.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Present-mode titles and the FinishScreen title. 32/40 below 600px. Arabic: display-xl-ar.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles and the child's name in the profile hero; the KidHeading title on phones. Arabic: display-lg-ar.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and section heads, dialog titles and empty-state headings. Always ink, never tone-coloured. Arabic: title-ar.

styles.name: kid-label
styles.usage: ChoiceCard labels (500), KidButton text and kid bubble titles (600). Arabic: kid-label-ar.

styles.name: kid-story
styles.sample: Adam built a tall tower, and the little red car drove under the arch.
styles.usage: Story page text in present mode, at most 30ch per line. Arabic: kid-story-ar.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Rubik covers Latin, Hebrew and Arabic in one face, so every teacher control has the same metrics in every language. Hebrew paragraphs use a 26px line. Dates, ages, times and counts use tabular numerals. Nothing is smaller than caption.

styles.name: name
styles.usage: Child names in lists and cards, the user name in the shell. Arabic: name-ar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Built a tall tower with Lina and asked her to add the roof.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, input text, observation text and quotes. Hebrew 16/26. Arabic: body-ar.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels at md and up, emphasis, timeline entry titles, toast text, picker and feedback tile labels. Hebrew 16/26. Arabic: body-strong-ar.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, field labels, side-nav items, tabs and segments; 600 when selected and on sm buttons. Arabic: label-ar.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, ages, helper text, badges and bottom-bar labels (500 for nav labels and badges). The floor: nothing is smaller. Arabic: caption-ar.

groups.name: Arabic display
groups.note: Baloo Bhaijaan 2 leads the display stack under :lang(ar). Its content area is 1.71em against Fredoka's 1.21em, so every Arabic display style is 2px larger with a line-height of at least 1.4.

styles.name: display-xl-ar
styles.usage: display-xl in Arabic. 34/48 below 600px.

styles.name: display-lg-ar
styles.usage: display-lg in Arabic: page titles, the child's name in the profile hero.

styles.name: title-ar
styles.usage: title in Arabic: card and section heads, dialog titles, empty-state headings.

styles.name: kid-label-ar
styles.usage: kid-label in Arabic: ChoiceCard labels (500), KidButton and bubble titles (600).

styles.name: kid-story-ar
styles.sample: بنى آدم برجاً عالياً، ومرّت السيارة الحمراء الصغيرة تحت القوس.
styles.usage: kid-story in Arabic: story page text in present mode, at most 30ch per line.

groups.name: Arabic body
groups.note: Rubik at the same sizes with taller lines for Arabic joining and marks; caption and label rise to 14/22, so Arabic never drops below 14px.

styles.name: name-ar
styles.usage: name in Arabic: child names in lists and cards.

styles.name: body-ar
styles.sample: بنى برجاً عالياً مع لينا وطلب منها أن تضيف السقف.
styles.usage: body in Arabic: paragraphs, inputs, observation text.

styles.name: body-strong-ar
styles.usage: body-strong in Arabic: buttons, emphasis, timeline titles, toasts.

styles.name: label-ar
styles.usage: label in Arabic: chips, field labels, side-nav items, tabs and segments.

styles.name: caption-ar
styles.usage: caption in Arabic: dates, ages, helper text, badges, bottom-bar labels (14/18 there).

spacing.note: 4px base, eight steps. Teacher controls are at least 44px tall, list rows 56px, child targets 64px (never below 56px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Segment and tab track padding and gaps, the gap between a badge glyph and its word, the bottom-bar icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, the icon-to-label gap inside buttons and chips, the gap after a numeral block, badge padding, progress-dot gaps, feedback-tile gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding-block, gaps inside cards, list and grid gaps, toast and alert gaps, side-nav padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phone, the page gutter on phone, gaps between sections inside a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding at md and up, primary-button padding-inline at lg.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, gaps between cards, the present-mode stage padding on phone, the FinishScreen gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page-section spacing, the page gutter at md and up, empty-state padding, xl button padding-inline.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Desktop page rhythm, the present-mode stage padding on tablet, the timeline entry inset.

radius.note: Blocks, not pills: chips and avatars are rounded squares. radius-round is only for true circles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, toggle chips, badges, mode tags, 32px section tiles, numeral and check blocks, avatars of 32px or less, toast glyph blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, IconButtons, inputs, selects, segmented and tab tracks and blocks, nav items and pills, alerts, toasts, content-type tiles, focus rows, avatars 40 to 56px, the centre Observe block.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, centred dialogs, feedback and picker tiles, kid picture blocks, the xl hero button, 80px avatars.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Kid ChoiceCards, KidButton, kid feedback bubbles, and the top corners of bottom sheets (border-start-start-radius and border-start-end-radius).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: True circles only: RoundButton, emoji pods, circle timeline beads, the sheet grabber.

shadow.note: Hard, unblurred block lips that sink when pressed; blur only on floating sheets. Dark depth comes from the 1px line border and the surface steps, not the lips.

tokens.name: shadow-lip
tokens.usage: Tappable cards at rest, secondary and danger buttons, the selected segment or tab block, selected feedback tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-lip-lg
tokens.usage: Card hover (with translateY(-1px)), picker-tile hover, kid ChoiceCards, the RoundButton and the plain KidButton.

tokens.name: shadow-lip-brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, the brand KidButton and the centre Observe block. Pressed, it becomes shadow-lip-brand-pressed as the block sinks 2px.

tokens.name: shadow-lip-brand-pressed
tokens.usage: The 1px lip of a pressed primary button, brand KidButton and Observe block, as the block sinks 2px.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, toasts and menus: the only blurred shadow.
